## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`uv run pytest` passes with 100 % coverage)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check` and `uv run mypy src tests` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (if user-visible)
- [ ] README / `.env.example` / `notify.example.yml` updated (if configuration changed)
- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squash commit message)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](https://developercertificate.org))
